subject.title: experimental.sessionMemory does not surface gateway-dispatched sessions in memory_search

question: Should OpenClaw accept owner-scoped live orphan session transcript hits in `memory_search` when the existing session visibility guard permits them, while handling broader private cross-conversation recall through the separate default-off product setting?
rationale: The remaining runtime gap sits on a transcript privacy boundary, and the open targeted fix plus the broader recall feature make this a human security/product decision rather than safe autonomous cleanup.

options.title: Land Narrow Visibility Fix First
options.body: Accept the targeted same-agent live-orphan repair, preserve cross-agent and sandbox fail-closed behavior, and keep automatic private recall as a separate feature review.

options.title: Fold Into Broader Recall Feature
options.body: Pause the narrow PR and resolve this only through the default-off remember-across-conversations surface after its conflicts and proof are refreshed.

options.title: Keep Current Fail-Closed Behavior
options.body: Require a session-store entry for live transcript hits and close the remaining recall gap as an intentional privacy tradeoff.

recommendation.title: Land Narrow Visibility Fix First
recommendation.body: Accept the targeted same-agent live-orphan repair, preserve cross-agent and sandbox fail-closed behavior, and keep automatic private recall as a separate feature review.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the overlapping maintainer-labeled product issue and broader implementation PR, so they are the clearest owner for the privacy/product accept-or-defer decision.
